verses.note: Proverb on இழுக்கம்/ஒழுக்கம் applied to the general case of holding forth (கட்டுரை) among கல்லாதவர்; no person or episode.
Item 2 begins with எல்லிற் on line 1 and runs into line 2; it implies visiting another's house by night but states no gender rule, so norm is null.
Norm tagged gender because item 1 values a wife by அருந்ததிக் கற்பு, a chastity ideal stated as praise rather than as an explicit rule; items 2-3 address anyone.
Line 3 carries an editorial bracket வெகுண்(டு); proverb is only the quoted line 4.
No count word: the five are grouped as நிகரில் குரவர் and listed by name, so items are given with count_word null; reverence for elders is not a purity, birth or gender rule.
Gender tagged for item 2 (a wife valued as கற்புடையாள்), an ideal stated as praise; item 1 (fame) is for anyone, so domain is a judgment call between householder and all.
இயக்கம் இரண்டும் names two of the four (the two excretions) in one phrase, so it is listed twice; the verse has only three lines and looks truncated or corrupt (உளமற் றவற்றுள்).
The quote opens mid line 3 at முடவன்; the lame man and elephant are the proverb's image, not a story the verse tells, applied to கல்லாதார் provoking கற்றார்.
Only three lines survive and line 3 does not complete the sense of நோக்கார், so the text looks truncated; புலை in the rule makes it caste as well as purity.
